rows.subject: a free-fleet grader scored a model 0 out of 4 because the grading regex demanded an ms suffix the answer format never mandated
rows.raw:
stickman + robot flail
CAP: "Model 0/4? That’s impossible!"

stickman + operator shimmy
CAP: "But the answer format never—"

stickman + robot pointy spirit stomp
CAP: "—required an ‘ms’ suffix!"

rows.raw:
stickman + robot flail "APIs are free!"
stickman pointy "Zero dollars, zero models..."
stickman shimmy "Eleven trials overnight..."
stickman stomp "All failed. Again."
